regions.today: Dry today with a mix of cloud and sunny spells. The sunshine will be hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 or 21 degrees with light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight with isolated patches of mist and the odd spot of drizzle possible in northern parts. Some clear spells also. Lowest temperatures of 8 to 12 degrees with light and variable winds.
regions.tomorrow: Any mist and drizzle will clear during the morning. Dry for the rest of the day with sunny spells, hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 15 to 20 degrees with light to moderate easterly winds developing during the morning. Coolest near the east coast.
regions.solar_uv: High in sunshine today and Sunday, otherwise moderate.
